# SevenTask Calculator

> SevenTask Calculator is a calculator workspace by Kawkab Tech Labs, with 136+ calculators for everyday math, money, business, science, and unit conversions.

## Public pages
- [Home](https://seventaskcalculator.in/): Product overview and calculator access.
- [Calculator](https://seventaskcalculator.in/calculator.html): Interactive calculator application.
- [Apps and downloads](https://seventaskcalculator.in/install): Web, Android, and Windows installation information.
- [How to Use](https://seventaskcalculator.in/promo/product-presentation): Product guide and presentation.
- [Privacy Policy and open-source licenses](https://seventaskcalculator.in/privacy-policy): Privacy information and third-party license notices.

## Product details
- Product name: SevenTask Calculator
- Publisher: Kawkab Tech Labs
- Current product version: 1.18.07
- Website: https://seventaskcalculator.in/
